title: Summit Loan Interest Accrual and Periodic Charges by Plan
content:
What accrues to the balance of a Cedarline Summit Proprietary Reverse Mortgage each month, plan by plan.

| Plan | How monthly interest is computed | Rounding of accruals | Posting day of the following month | Mortgage insurance | Monthly servicing fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Fixed Lump Sum | one twelfth of the note rate on the balance at the end of the prior month | half up to the cent | 1 | none | USD 0.00 |
| Summit Flex Fixed | one twelfth of the note rate on the balance at the end of the prior month | half up to the cent | 1 | none | USD 0.00 |
| Summit Select Line | one twelfth of the note rate on the balance at the end of the prior month | half up to the cent | 1 | none | USD 0.00 |
| Summit Condo Line | one twelfth of the note rate on the balance at the end of the prior month | half up to the cent | 1 | none | USD 0.00 |
| Summit Second Lien | one twelfth of the note rate on the balance at the end of the prior month | half up to the cent | 1 | none | USD 0.00 |
| Summit Estate Line | one twelfth of the note rate on the balance at the end of the prior month | half up to the cent | 1 | none | USD 0.00 |

## Reading the table

- Every Summit plan computes interest the same way: the month's interest is one twelfth of the note rate applied to the balance standing at the end of that month, and it is posted on day 1 of the following month.
- Accruals are rounded half up to the cent: a third decimal place of 5 or more raises the cent, a lower one leaves it.
- No Summit plan charges mortgage insurance, and the monthly servicing fee is USD 0.00 under every plan, so interest is the only monthly charge that accrues to the balance.
